_: Catatumbo (painting-company row 327), its light over the mouth of the Catatumbo on Lake Maracaibo, where lightning flickers most nights of the year: a window onto the night lake, a stroke forking down to it now and then. Touched, the window shows the toy itself and grows as the Earth turns to it and falls toward it, until it is the glass; the Earth mark, and it shrinks back into its light (row 245).
